---
title: "Online Resources"
subtitle: "Supplementary material for: Systematic Review of Soil Moisture monitoring using Unmanned Aircraft Systems"

date: last-modified

bibliography: full_papers_review.bib
csl: elsevier-harvard.csl
link-citations: true

# Numbering must match review.qmd: it is generated from the order of the
# `#or-*` divs in 92_appendix/_online-resources.qmd.
crossref:
  custom:
    - kind: float
      key: or
      reference-prefix: "Online Resource"
      caption-prefix: "Online Resource"
      space-before-numbering: true

format:
  docx:
    # The appendix is almost only wide tables, so it is printed A4 landscape.
    # Rebuild with: python _make_landscape_reference.py
    reference-doc: _reference-landscape.docx
    toc: false
    number-sections: false
  html:
    toc: false
    number-sections: false
  pdf:
    # Springer SI wants PDF (docx is not the archival format).
    # Same landscape A4 as the Word file. Render:
    #   quarto render online-resources.qmd --to pdf
    documentclass: article
    papersize: a4
    geometry:
      - landscape
      - margin=12mm
    toc: false
    number-sections: false
    colorlinks: true
    fig-pos: "H"

execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false

engine: knitr

filters:
  - _filters/linebreaks.lua

editor:
  markdown:
    wrap: 72
---
